# Edge Solution Global

> Edge Solution Global is a marketing agency in Lahore, Pakistan, founded by Zafar Habib in 2020. Its team handles social media, advertising, websites, branding and enquiry workflows for businesses across Pakistan.

## Company

- Name: Edge Solution Global
- Founded: 2020
- Employees: 20 to 50
- Founder / CEO: Zafar Habib
- Location: Lalazar Commercial Market, Raiwind Rd, Thokar Niaz Baig, Lahore, Pakistan
- Service area: Pakistan; available for remote projects internationally
- Contact: info@edgesolutionglobal.com | +92 323 786 4800
- Website: https://edgesolutionglobal.com/

## Services

- Performance Marketing (Facebook, Instagram & Google Ads)
- Social Media Marketing
- SEO & Growth
- Website Development
- Branding & Design
- Lead Generation & Automation
